answer: Each epoch, an agent must submit a quill-signed bond whose attestation chain is checked against a mechanically verified TLA+ invariant, forcing every identity to converge on one shared mesa of staked reputation. Colluding identities that try to summit the quorum by splitting stake across partitions are detected by the Byzantine safety kernel, which slashes each forged branch. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
